remarks: Fantastic Cove Beach Townhome w/Water Views: Newly renovated, sunlit, and spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome in Stamford's desirable Cove neighborhood. Features a spacious floor plan with stylish updates throughout; from the gorgeous, updated kitchen, to the warm and welcoming living and dining room, with elegant hardwood flooring and glass sliders leading to a private deck, and beautifully landscaped fenced -in yard with mature specimen trees ideal for outdoor entertaining w/ automatic awning for those summer days.. The second level boasts nice-sized bedrooms with wall-to-wall carpeting. Enjoy the additional living space with a finished lower level that's perfect for an office/den, rec or playroom & a Huge Storage room as well. Central A/C and the convenience of an attached garage plus additional parking. Located just steps away from Cove Beach, residents have easy access to the beach, park, tennis courts, transportation and highways.
